scenario: A persisted version-1 annotation anchor follows a context-proven repeated quote after synthetic refreshed content shifts its position, but never silently attaches when the current text makes the same quote ambiguous; the saved annotation remains visible as an explicit unresolved state.

failure_before_repair.result: failed: annotationAnchor did not export a resolver, so refreshed repeated text had no restoration contract
failed: highlights did not expose an anchor-aware renderer, so the UI could only select the first matching quote

repair: Added a context-only resolver that returns resolved, ambiguous, or not-found without trusting the stored position by itself.
Rendered persisted anchors only when the resolved range maps to one safe plain-text HTML range; retained legacy unanchored first-match rendering for backwards compatibility.
Added a visible unresolved-annotation status while retaining the saved note and deterministic repeated/ambiguous Reader fixtures.

validation.command: npx playwright test e2e/service-worker.smoke.spec.ts --grep refreshed repeated annotations

known_limit: This covers plain-text ranges in sanitized HTML, one shifted repeated quote, and one ambiguous rejection. It does not claim inline-markup range restoration, alternate input methods, retries, or multi-user isolation; A-03 and A-04 remain IN_PROGRESS.
